name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim tool-call-scored compaction for Claude Code sessions: Jev, or Haiku through the session itself (no extra key).

backend.title: Judge backend
backend.description: Who scores the tool calls: 'claude' uses the session API client; 'fork' uses the session transcript (experimental); 'jev' uses TypeSafe; 'openai' uses the OpenAI Responses API with explicit openaiModel and its own key; 'auto' picks jev when a TypeSafe key is set, else claude.

arbiterModel.title: Arbiter model
arbiterModel.description: Model alias or id (haiku, sonnet, ...) that re-judges, through the session's own API client, the calls Jev was unsure about: those within arbitrateBand of a threshold. Its answer replaces Jev's; the decisions log shows both. Empty turns the arbiter off. Only with the Jev judge.

arbitrateBand.title: Arbitration band
arbitrateBand.description: Half-width of the band around keepThreshold and keepCallThreshold whose calls go to the arbiter; 0.15 sends a call with keepCall between 0.35 and 0.65.

timeoutMs.title: Judge request timeout
timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds one judge request may take before the round is given up and the built-in summary runs; 0 waits forever.

claudeModel.title: Claude judge model
claudeModel.description: Model alias or id for the Claude judge (backend=claude), e.g. haiku.

openaiModel.title: OpenAI judge model
openaiModel.description: Explicit model id for backend=openai. No model is selected automatically.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Only for backend=openai. Leave unset to use OPENAI_API_KEY.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep-result threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum probability that a tool result is still useful for it to stay verbatim; below it the result is cut to a head.

keepCallThreshold.title: Keep-call threshold
keepCallThreshold.description: Minimum probability that a tool call still matters for it to stay (with a bounded result); below it the call becomes a stub or is removed.

dropCalls.title: Unneeded calls
dropCalls.description: 'stub' keeps the tool name, a short input and a note in place of the result, so the history keeps its shape; 'delete' removes the call and its result and marks the turn's narration.

stubChars.title: Stub input characters
stubChars.description: Characters of input kept on a stubbed call.

pruneMachineText.title: Cut host blocks
pruneMachineText.description: Cut system reminders, task notifications and command echoes in old user messages to a head and a note; the person's own words are never touched.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction; it does not fire again until the context has fallen 10 points below, or grown 10 points past the last trigger.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum prunable share
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum share of the history that is tool traffic or host blocks for a Jev round to run at all; below it, see nothingToPrune.

nothingToPrune.title: When too little is prunable
nothingToPrune.description: 'keep' leaves the history unchanged (an automatic compaction at the window limit still gets the built-in summary); 'summary' always hands it to the built-in summary.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum state tokens per request
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for one request's state (Jev reads at most 32k). The Claude judge defaults to 80000 when unset.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for one request's state plus its questions. The Claude judge defaults to 100000 when unset.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters kept of a tool result, an oversized input field or a host block once the rest is cut; 0 keeps only the note.
